What happens when I take over a local Indian street egg stall and start selling eggs myself?
In this India Vlog , I decided to try something completely different! I temporarily took over a roadside egg stall in India and started selling eggs for just ₹1 PER EGG!
I wanted to experience the Indian street market, interact with local people, meet customers, etc
This India trip is full of unexpected experiences, real-life interactions, fitness, food and entertainment.
